change: Detect user execution rule inputs before and after the official status check and report the cause without reading rule contents. Keep the native command and its execution-policy enforcement.
mechanism: The ordinary exec command reads user rule inputs independently of user config. A synthetic invalid rule prevented endpoint contact. Separate diagnostic countercontrols distinguished policy loading from process or transport startup.

native_envelope_line_endings.transformation: Converted CRLF to LF. JSON values and native subprocess digests are unchanged.

scope: Source-bound Codex CLI startup and admission controls using isolated unsigned homes and an owned scripted peer.
